newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: VAGNORIUS SEES FOREIGN-DOMINATED BANK SECTOR.
newsitem.headline: VAGNORIUS SEES FOREIGN-DOMINATED BANK SECTOR.

text.p: Lithuanian Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius said on Thursday that he saw the country's banking sector as eventually being dominated by foreign capital.

"We see our bank sector in the future as being dominated by foreign capital," Vagnorius told an investor forum organised by the Lithuanian Investment Agency, where banks and companies were represented.
He said the government was determined to make the bank and other sectors more open and liberal for foreign investors.
He also noted that state banks were to be privatised.
"We believe that the privatisation of state banks will strengthen the sector," he added.
He said this would lower interest rates and make credit cheaper to businesses.
